comment: Pages that are built and kept in sync but must NOT be reachable. Read by scripts/copy-static-files.sh (to keep them out of public/) and by backend/src/server.js (to refuse them at request time). Both are needed: leaving a page out of public/ is not enough, because Vercel hands any unmatched *.html to the Express function, which serves from the repository root where the file still exists.
